summary: Titan Acquisition Corp (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Business Combination Agreement on June 1, 2026. Titan will merge into PubCo (OpenPayd Global Holdings), with all outstanding Titan securities exchanged for equivalent PubCo securities; PubCo will acquire all Company shares (OpenPayd Holdings) for PubCo ordinary shares. Public shareholders may elect redemption for a pro rata trust account distribution. No deal price, premium, or advisor named; mechanics are standard SPAC merger with no stated break fee. Watch: shareholder vote, redemption levels, and Nasdaq listing timelines for risk-arb.
